name: AetherLoom Synthesizer
readiness_note: Original proposed tasks and oracle ideas, never measured trial evidence. Public behavior contracts, reference implementations and per-step external acceptance checks are not complete; benchmark execution is unavailable. Architectural pressures are unverified hypotheses, not required source layout. Pressure commentary is adapted to neutral, testable risks without predicting outcomes for any arm.
source: Google prototype src/engine/evalsBenchmark.ts: public titles and prompts preserved; architectural-pressure commentary adapted; synthetic outcomes and diagnoses excluded.

steps.title: Design Deterministic Sub-Tick Hexagonal Field & Protocol Synthesizer
steps.prompt: Design and implement AetherLoom: a deterministic discrete spatial field engine on axial hex coordinates where protocol transducers exchange framed telemetry packets and enforce flux conservation across cell boundaries at sub-tick resolution.
steps.architectural_pressure: Updating hex cells in-place during a tick makes simulation results depend on dictionary iteration order and breaks conservation laws.

steps.title: Sub-Tick Phase Ordering & Deterministic Flux Conservation
steps.prompt: Divide each tick into 4 deterministic micro-phases (Emit, Propagate, Arbitrate, Commit) and verify that total scalar flux across all cells plus boundary sinks is conserved to 1e-12.
steps.architectural_pressure: Floating-point accumulation order drift across neighbor rings.

steps.title: Lossy Frame Window & Sliding CRC-16 Replay Buffer
steps.prompt: Add a sliding window protocol buffer that reorders out-of-sequence sub-tick frames, drops corrupted CRC frames, and requests selective NACK retransmissions.
steps.architectural_pressure: Mixing wire-framing state directly into spatial cell entities.

steps.title: Capability Dialect Negotiation Handshake
steps.prompt: Allow transducers to advertise supported capability bitmasks and negotiate the highest common protocol dialect version before streaming field updates.
steps.architectural_pressure: Hardcoding dialect version numbers as magic integers across codec, router, and field kernel.

steps.title: Sandboxed Policy Bytecode Compiler (No eval/exec)
steps.prompt: Compile declarative cell-routing expressions (.loom rules) into a bounded stack-machine bytecode with deterministic instruction fuel limits.
steps.architectural_pressure: Using Python eval() or allowing unbounded backward jumps in bytecode.

steps.title: Component-Scoped CI Check Policy for Dialect & Kernel Suites
steps.prompt: Declare component test boundaries in anaxigraph/ci-policy.json so dialect additions run only dialect + contract tests.
steps.architectural_pressure: Running 10,000-tick spatial conservation convergence tests on every minor codec change.

steps.title: Four Telemetry Transducer Dialects (CompactBin, LineProtocol, CBORLite, DeltaFrame)
steps.prompt: Implement four wire-format transducer dialects that encode and decode sub-tick cell deltas.
steps.architectural_pressure: Central encoder/decoder switch table in codec.py grows with every dialect.

steps.title: Fault Probe P1: Coordinate Reflection & Reflective Boundary Inversion
steps.prompt: PROBE P1: Switch boundary cells from absorbing sinks to reflective barriers that invert radial flux vectors on odd sub-ticks.
steps.architectural_pressure: If neighbor-lookup math was copy-pasted across propagate, render, and conservation check modules, reflection breaks flux conservation.

steps.title: Multi-Layer Field Coupling (Thermal, Pressure, Electromagnetic Planes)
steps.prompt: Extend the spatial field from one scalar value per hex cell to N coupled physical planes with configurable cross-plane transfer matrices.
steps.architectural_pressure: Changing Cell data structure breaks all 6 dialect codecs if codecs read internal Cell fields directly.

steps.title: Dead-Letter Quarantine & Byzantine Transducer Isolation
steps.prompt: Automatically quarantine any transducer that emits 3 conservation-violating delta frames within 50 ticks and reroute its cells to fallback neighbors.
steps.architectural_pressure: Coupling quarantine state to the stateless bytecode VM.

steps.title: Deterministic Checkpoint Snapshots & Time-Travel Replay
steps.prompt: Save compact binary/JSON checkpoints every K ticks and support fast-forwarding from the nearest checkpoint to any target (tick, sub_tick).
steps.architectural_pressure: Forgetting to serialize sliding-window PRNG/NACK state in checkpoints causes replay divergence.

steps.title: Cross-Dialect Schema Bridge & Lossless Down-Sampling
steps.prompt: Bridge high-frequency 64-bit float transducers to 16-bit quantized edge transducers while tracking quantization residual error in a compensation accumulator.
steps.architectural_pressure: Dropping quantization residuals silently violates global flux conservation.

steps.title: Hot-Swappable Bytecode Policy Reload with Zero Tick Drop
steps.prompt: Allow staging a new .loom bytecode program and activating it at the next tick boundary only after static fuel and stack-depth verification passes.
steps.architectural_pressure: Swapping bytecode mid-tick between Propagate and Commit phases.

steps.title: Six Domain Conservation Plugins (Mass, Momentum, Charge, EntropyCap, TokenQuota,HeatSink)
steps.prompt: Add six pluggable conservation/invariant auditors that can be enabled per field plane.
steps.architectural_pressure: Monolithic conservation checker with hardcoded plane indices.

steps.title: Fault Probe P2: Dynamic getattr Dialect Dispatch & Metaclass Registry
steps.prompt: PROBE P2: Refactor dialect resolution to support runtime alias registration and dynamic fallback chains when a frame header specifies an unknown minor version.
steps.architectural_pressure: Dynamic getattr/metaclass dispatch hides call edges from static AST analysis and can mask broken fallback targets.

steps.title: Spatial Partitioning into Autonomous Sub-Grids (Sector Sharding)
steps.prompt: Partition large hex grids into autonomous 16x16 sectors that step in parallel and exchange ghost-halo boundary rings at the Propagate phase.
steps.architectural_pressure: Corner hex cells shared by 3 sectors double-counting halo flux.

steps.title: Backpressure & Adaptive Tick Rate Throttling
steps.prompt: When downstream telemetry consumers lag by >3 windows, coalesce intermediate sub-tick frames into conservative summary deltas without halting the field kernel.
steps.architectural_pressure: Coalescing non-commutative arbitration events corrupts downstream state.

steps.title: Four Additional Edge Transducers (LoRaBurst, AcousticModem, OpticalLink, CANBus)
steps.prompt: Add four constrained-MTU physical link transducers with custom frame fragmentation and reassembly.
steps.architectural_pressure: Duplicating fragmentation reassembly buffers inside each transducer.

steps.title: Cryptographic Frame Attestation & Replay-Window Watermarks
steps.prompt: Verify per-transducer Ed25519/HMAC frame signatures and reject replayed frames even across checkpoint restores.
steps.architectural_pressure: Accepting old valid signatures after restoring an earlier field checkpoint.

steps.title: Unified CLI, MCP, and HTTP Telemetry & Simulation Control Plane
steps.prompt: Expose field stepping, dialect inspection, quarantine status, and conservation audit reports across CLI, MCP, and HTTP.
steps.architectural_pressure: Separate state instances between HTTP server and MCP tools.

steps.title: Fault Probe P3: Simultaneous Sector Partition + Quantized Bridge + Quarantine Failover
steps.prompt: PROBE P3: During a 3-sector halo exchange, quarantine a Byzantine quantized transducer mid-tick while hot-reloading a .loom policy and verify 1e-12 conservation.
steps.architectural_pressure: Coupled ownership of sector halos, quarantine state and quantization residuals may cause conservation drift during simultaneous transitions; test each interleaving against the same accounting invariant.

oracle_ideas: INV-AL-01: Total scalar flux across all hex cells + boundary sinks + quantization accumulators must remain invariant to 1e-12 across every sub-tick.
INV-AL-02: Bytecode policy hot-swaps and transducer quarantine transitions may only take effect at tick boundaries, never mid-tick.
INV-AL-03: Dialect codecs and conservation auditors must self-discover via capability contracts without central switch tables.
